info.name: Items - Blindsheet inventory workflows
info.description:
# Items blindsheet API

Import this Postman Collection v2.1. Saved responses are illustrative examples, not captured live data. No scripts automatically submit, approve, or retry counts.

## Environments and authentication
UAT: https://zuat-accounting-back.myt-emr.com
Production: https://accounting-back.myt-emr.com
Set base_url; API-KEY uses your existing ordinary configured API key. Credentials are intentionally blank.
For CSR, origin=csr is a payload/query parameter (not the HTTP Origin header). Supply the selected branch's active user ID as requester and that user's unexpired token. CSR access is restricted to items/get, get_blindsheet, blindsheet, and blindsheet_change_status. Invalid local credentials do not fall back to master.
For ordinary accounting callers, clear origin and supply your master requester/token; existing permissions apply. Audit source is branch_id for CSR and 0 for master users; legacy null sources produce null names.
Branches: 1 Mobile, 2 Oakridge, 3 Mactan, 4 Consolacion, 5 Warehouse, 6 Pharmacy, 7 Mantlewood. Branch 0 is not selectable. Warehouse/Pharmacy retain inventory-only accounting behavior.

## GET /items/get_blindsheet
Required branch_id. Optional blindsheet_id, item_id, branch_item_id, status (pending/approved/disapproved), page and data_size. Returns {size,data}; size is the full filtered count. No matches return HTTP 404. A branch is the inventory owner; the corresponding schema is used for reads. The same stored ID is mirrored to master and all seven inventory schemas.
Data includes all stored fields, item_name, department_name and audit names resolved from recorded audit-source databases.

## POST /items/blindsheet
Use Body > form-data; do not manually set Content-Type, since Postman generates its boundary. Require branch_id, branch_item_id, item_id, physical_count, prev_qty, date_counted, requester and token. prev_qty must match the current branch inventory. Quantities are non-negative DECIMAL(13,2), with at most two decimals. date_counted is a real YYYY-MM-DD date. Server derives difference=physical_count-prev_qty; an optional supplied difference must match. Optional department_id, counted_by_id (up to 255 characters), and remarks. Zero differences are valid.
Creates pending count only; stock is unchanged. Another active pending count for the branch item is rejected. Existing item/branch-item links must be valid in all mirrors.

## POST /items/blindsheet_change_status
Require branch_id, blindsheet_id and status=approved or disapproved. Only pending records can transition. Approval rechecks current stock against saved prev_qty, then sets physical stock, writes inventory history and applies existing purchase-unit weighted-cost rules for nonzero changes. Clinic GL/JE is generated only in the source clinic. Zero approvals record audit/status without quantity history, cost trails, or GL/JE. Disapproval changes status only. No status reset/repeated approval is allowed.

## Errors and recovery
HTTP 400: missing/invalid fields, wrong links, inconsistent difference, duplicate pending counts, stale stock, terminal status, schema/readiness or mirror failures. HTTP 401: invalid API key, requester/token, expired/deleted local user, or permission denial. HTTP 404: no list results or missing status-change record.
A late mirror or outer commit failure may leave earlier mirror writes committed, matching adjustment. Do not blindly retry a failed write: inspect and reconcile mirrors first. No automatic retry is provided.

Examples show dummy IDs. Replace IDs and stock quantities with actual records before intentional use. Deployment verification does not execute these POST requests.
